snippet: For a true cricket fan, the real World Cup final happens before the match: getting a ticket. #Ahmedabad has now hosted some of the biggest matches in world cricket - World Cup clashes, IPL finals, and now the 2026 T20 World Cup Final. But there is one pattern that keeps repeating. > Tickets open. > Tickets disappear within minutes. > And soon after, they appear in the black market at multiples of the original price. This has been happening repeatedly. ▶️ 2023 ODI World Cup Final – India vs [...] reaching 4 - 6x At this point, calling it “mismanagement” feels too simplistic. It looks more like a structural flaw in ticket distribution. I do not know what is holding it back, but it seems like ICC, BCCI, or BookMyShow wants to keep on doing it. Because when a 132,000-seat stadium sells out instantly every single time, the obvious question becomes: "How many tickets actually reach genuine fans?" If Ahmedabad is positioning itself as a global destination for marquee cricket events, the [...] Final – India vs Australia Probably the biggest cricket match India has hosted in decades.
